thread:
incident-bot: Pager triggered -> HIGH severity: auth-service token-validate errors spike (>90% 5xx). Affected: hosted API and Dedicated auth checks. PD alert: pd-incident-9271.

pagerduty: Incident pd-9271 created and notified: escalation policy 'auth-oncall'.

Alex: acked oncall. I'm looking. seeing a surge in jwt-validate failures from edge (502 from auth).

Priya: tagging @Marco for key rotation history — did we push a JWKS change in the last deploy window?

Marco: not in prod today. Only small config push to staging. No JWKS rotate. Checking jwks cache metrics now.

Eve: throwing up dashboards — jwt_verify_error rate went from ~0.2% to 93% at 13:02 UTC. errors are `kid mismatch` and `no matching key`.

Alex: can someone paste an example error from logs?

Priya: here — auth-service logs from host auth-12: `ERROR AuthVerifier - jwt verification failed: no key found for kid 'kJH7s' in JWKS`.

Tom: Confirmed: our JWKS endpoint /auth/.well-known/jwks.json returns the old key set without newly-added signing key. Upstream signing service shows key rotated at 12:58 UTC. Looks like propagation failed.

Marco: Oh — the signer rotated keys but management API returned 202 and didn't push to the distributed store — we retried once then aborted. Root cause might be a transient DB write timeout.

Alex: mitigation plan: 1) Add temporary fallback in auth-service to accept previous signing key thumbprint from cache. 2) Roll forward — re-publish current JWKS from signer and force cache invalidation on auth nodes. 3) Inform support and customers. Who can trigger a JWKS re-publish?

Marco: I can force re-publish now. Doing `signerctl publish-jwks --force`. Will monitor propagation.

incident-bot: Action started by Marco: `signerctl publish-jwks --force` (cmd id 8f3b).

Priya: Alex, can you put a hotfix in auth-service to accept last-known key while we propagate? I can review.

Alex: pushing small change to enable `ALLOW_LEGACY_JWKS=1` flag via runtime config. Will patch one canary host first.

Tom: propagation visible — jwks.json now includes new and previous keys on signer. Hitting auth-10 cache flush endpoint on all boxes. `curl -XPOST http://auth-10.internal/flush-jwks` returns 200.

Eve: jwt error rate dropping — 93% -> 12% within 3 minutes. Good sign.

Priya: Pager update: PD incident acknowledged by Alex, Escalation paused. Updating status to "mitigating, partial restore".

Alex: Canary patch enabled on auth-10, logs show legacy key accepted. Routing for hosts in us-west still showing some failures. Flushing CDN edge caches for JWKS TTL incantations.

Marco: I re-run signer publish with increased write retries and verified the store write succeeded. Also added a check to validate store read-after-write.

Tom: After full flush, error rate down to 0.5%. No customer-facing 5xxs reported in last 5m.

Eve: monitoring-bot: alert suppression for pd-9271 set for 30m while we observe.

Priya: Customer impact summary for support: Between 12:58-13:08 UTC ~600k requests experienced token validation failures. Most were short-lived; major clients auto-retry succeeded. No token issuance compromise.

Alex: Next steps: 1) revert `ALLOW_LEGACY_JWKS` flag after 1 hour if stable. 2) postmortem to include signer publish reliability (add 5s retries, circuit-breaker alerts). 3) run a simulated rotate in staging with forced store failures.

Marco: I'll open a follow-up ticket for signer: PROD-2387 (increase publish retries + verify read-after-write).

Eve: handing off to next oncall — @Priya you're on-call for next 2h?

Priya: I'm on it. Leaving a note in the PD incident with steps and flags.

Alex: Great work team. Closing PD once 60m stable.

Tom: small snippet of commands we ran for reference:

```
# force publish
signerctl publish-jwks --force --request-id 8f3b
# flush all auth nodes
for h in auth-{1..16}; do curl -s -XPOST http://$h.internal/flush-jwks; done
# toggle legacy acceptor
consul kv put feature/auth/allow_legacy_jwks true
```

Priya: adding retrospective note: patch signerctl to return 201 only after store-read verification.

incident-bot: Incident pd-9271 — mitigation in progress, monitoring.

Alex: last check: error rate stable at 0.2% and no new PD pages. I'll follow up on postmortem doc. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
